guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Open the Genesis Vault and Connect Your Wallet
guide.description: Go to the HertzFlow Genesis Vault page and connect an EVM wallet. Anything supported by Privy works, including OKX Wallet, MetaMask, and Rabby. No invite code, no whitelist.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Wallet
guide.description: You need USD1 or U plus a little BNB for gas. Stablecoins can be bought on Bybit and withdrawn straight to BNB Chain. If your funds sit elsewhere, the widget below will bridge or swap them across. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Review and Accept the User Agreement
guide.description: Three disclosures gate the deposit form: smart contract risk, PnL exposure after mainnet, and the custody path. Deposits are wrapped into the underlying USD1 or U and held in Ceffu custody, so read it rather than clicking past.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit USD1 or U Into the Genesis Vault
guide.description: Enter at least $10 after fees, then approve and confirm. Holding a different token is fine, since the deposit flow swaps into USD1 or U first. Once the phase cap fills, the vault stops taking new money while existing deposits keep running.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Bind Your X and Discord Accounts
guide.description: Optional, and it changes nothing about deposits or Merits. It does register you for future campaign eligibility, so there is little reason to skip.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Hold the Deposit for 90 Continuous Days
guide.description: The boost is all or nothing. A deposit held 89 days earns the base rate; at 90 days it earns 10x on everything accrued over that window. After day 90 the boost stops growing, but base Merits keep accruing.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Once Season 2 Opens
guide.description: Perpetual trading opens in Season 2 once the Season 1 window closes, and depositors are already on the early access list. Trading uses a separate on-chain referral system that has not launched yet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
